items.item: `Sources/W3C EPUB Shared/W3C_EPUB.Version.swift`: `v2_0_1` is stored as 2.0 because the

api_changes: W3C_EPUB.FixedLayouts.Viewport.width/height and init(width:height:) are now Int instead of Double (preconditions removed; non-finite sizes and silent truncation are impossible).

W3C_EPUB.Version gains `public let patch: Int`; init is now init(major:minor:patch: Int = 0) (source compatible). v2_0_1 is now 2.0.1 and no longer equals Version(major: 2, minor: 0); description prints the patch only when non-zero.
dependents: None found: no package outside swift-w3c-epub references FixedLayouts.Viewport or Version(major:); swift-compositions/swift-epub-render and swift-standards/swift-epub-standard only use W3C_EPUB.Version.v3_3 / the type, which stay source compatible.
notes: Decided on Int (whole CSS pixels) over a throwing init: matches what metaContent always wrote. The exit-test for NaN was replaced with tests of size and metaContent. README laws updated in 50dfe30dca902b0ea130565748b7f3e4cf4cc45f.
